title: CUError
description: Structured error envelope for computer-use tool calls. The MCP layer returns these as isError tool results with this JSON in the text content. Unknown states fail closed: when policy state is unknown the answer is denied, not assumed.

recoverable.description: true = the same call can succeed after a re-observation or state change (stale, busy). false = the call must change (unknown_session, out_of_policy, version_unsupported).
